{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check unique sites
unique_sites = df['site'].unique()
print(f'Unique sites in data: {unique_sites}')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1].index
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_ids: {len(duplicate_patients)}')
print(f'Duplicate patient_ids: {duplicate_patients.tolist()}')"}
